flaggedResidues.id: flaggedResidue: confirmed and out of scope, and measured as n=1 rather than a lane. Re-verified the carrier sweep myself: the character's four land-Speed lanes (speeds / speedsIf / landSpeedBonus / landSpeedMin / speedAdjust, derive.ts:5222-5296) all target the CHARACTER, and the companion's land Speed at src/rules/companions.ts:404 (`speeds.land += m.speedBonus + (spec?.speedBonus ?? 0) + gear.speedBonus`) takes exactly three addends — maturity, specialization, invested companion gear — all companion-side, with no character-feature addend; CompanionMod.speeds (companions.ts:531-536) is a Math.max SET of extra speed TYPES, so even the existing grants lane cannot express "+5 feet". A real redirect therefore needs BOTH a character-feature→companion-speed addend in another family's file (src/rules/companions.ts / src/rules/derive.ts) AND a player-facing mounted state, which the engine does not have: a scan of every mounted clause in src returns only situational stars (`when: "while mounted…"`, situationalBonuses.ts:2424/2426/2438/2547/3309/3465) and notes — zero mounted-state carriers. Scale measured over public/core-descriptions.json: 8 records mention a mount gaining something, 5 of which (faithful-steed, auspicious-mount, specialized-mount, behold-a-pale-horse, night-terror) are ordinary companion grants already carried by src/rules/companionGrants.ts, and the remaining 3 (classes/champion, classFeatures/blessing-of-the-devoted, classFeatures/blessed-swiftness) are the SAME single Blessed Swiftness clause — so the whole mechanic is one clause in the game. The house precedent already settles it without an owner ruling: situationalBonuses.ts:4358 swift-paragon carries the identical "if you're mounted … the mount instead" redirect as a disclosure note rather than a mechanical redirect, exactly what work/.b036-rows-data-rows-1.json now does for this record, so no owner question is owed (print settles the mechanic, WG encodes strictly less — bare addBonusToValue SPEED 5 status). The player-visible half already ships in this batch; building a mounted mode plus a companion-speed addend lane for one clause is speculative infrastructure and belongs to a measured engine lane, not to batch 036. No double-count to fix meanwhile: I dumped the siblings and only blessed-swiftness carries landSpeedBonus (blessing-of-the-devoted, blessed-shield and blessed-armament carry none).
